name: qserve
description: QServe — Local Restaurant Operating System. Offline-first, modular, perpetual-licensed restaurant operations platform.

scripts.validate: npm run validate:tracked && npm run validate:syntax && npm run validate:i18n && npm run validate:themes && npm run validate:audit && npm run validate:version && npm run validate:supabase
scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run start
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run validate && npm test
scripts.build:vendor: node tools/build-vendor-config.mjs && cd apps/vendor && flutter build apk --release --split-per-abi && flutter build windows --release
scripts.build:all: npm run build:restaurant && npm run build:phone && npm run build:vendor
